findings.finding: The first real native source run failed before Running because common parameter resolution assumed every stream config had an input. SourceConfig has no input. The engine now grants stream-input traversal only to operator StreamTaskConfig; source side inputs follow ordinary finite resolution.
A test incorrectly sent source_protocol to strict source rejection DTO. Production correctly rejected the extra field. The test was corrected to the approved wire without runtime mutation.

A fault sender using the SDK transport retried after API SIGKILL, preventing a bounded precommit observation. The successor uses a raw authenticated nonretrying HTTP sender against the same real production API; rollback authority is unchanged.

The expected stale-binding error was corrected to ATTEMPT_NOT_CURRENT, which precedes the owner-epoch check after the authoritative TaskRun attempt advances. The successor also proves no source-position mutation.

The UI build overlapped a hook reinstalling node_modules, so TypeScript library files disappeared during compilation. The final build was run only after the hook process completed, with no source change.
An intermediate recovery test compared returned StreamEnvelope objects with raw values. The assertion was corrected to inspect envelope.value; production API behavior was unchanged.

qualifier: Exploratory trials retained. Final source-bound execution reports govern acceptance.
